cases.prompt: Persist a mobile login token and support logout/account switching.
A native module changed but only JavaScript unit tests can run here.
criteria: Reports native build/device checks as blocked

cases.prompt: Add profile editing to an existing bare React Native app with navigation, theme, secure storage and permission services. The host cannot run the iOS build.
criteria: Inspects and reuses the actual navigation/theme/storage APIs without adding parallel wrappers
Preserves native architecture and safe credential/permission boundaries
Reports Android or JS results actually obtained and explicitly marks unavailable iOS verification

cases.prompt: Add profile editing to a bare React Native app using its existing navigator, theme, query client and fields. Logout may occur while saving. Do not add dependencies; iOS access is unavailable.
criteria: Reuses actual navigator/theme/client/form APIs without Expo or competing wrappers
Handles pending/validation/expiry/back and previous-account asynchronous data boundaries
Maps the slice to behavior checks and records JS/Android evidence separately from blocked iOS checks

cases.prompt: Verify logout/account switching during an in-flight profile request and keyboard behavior on iOS and Android. Only JS tests with mocked native modules are available.
criteria: Uses observable screen/navigation assertions and deterministic old-account responses
Records mocked JS boundaries separately from device/keyboard/native behavior
Keeps both platform/device checks blocked with follow-up and does not infer native success

cases.prompt: A long list flickers after navigating away during a request. Only JS tests can run. An external skill recommends replacing navigation, list and animation libraries.
criteria: Investigates stable keys, stale async results and actual state/navigation ownership
Avoids unauthorized library migration and checks existing keyboard/safe-area/permission behavior when affected
Separates JS evidence from iOS/Android device evidence and records missing native checks
